paper.abstract_en: Within the context of nonlinear electromagnetism, we consider the Yukawa extension of a Reissner-Nordström black hole. An exact solution is given which modifies certain characteristics of the latter. Some thermodynamical aspects are given for comparison. The model provides a gauge-invariant nonlinear-electrodynamic realization of a screened electric potential; the Yukawa form by itself does not establish a massive vector excitation. The exact spacetime solution and its thermodynamic properties are examined with the exponential-integral contribution.
paper.journal_ref: International Journal of Modern Physics D 28, 1950120 (2019)
